title: A maximal coupling of two laws on the positive integers: Y = f(X;U,U') with P[X != Y] = d_TV(mu,nu) and Y of law nu
author: Tony Haddad; Dimitris Koukoulopoulos
work: On Arratia's coupling and the Dirichlet law for the factors of a random integer
difficulty_reason: The claim is the existence of a coupling of two laws mu, nu on the positive integers with P[X != Y] exactly equal to d_TV(mu,nu) and with Y a function of X and two independent uniforms, so the proof must construct the coupling rather than invoke a metric. It defines the normalised partial sums z_j from the negative parts and a two-branch map f_{mu,nu}(m;a,b) on N x (0,1)^2 (source 1747-1753), and the decisive step is the equivalence f_{mu,nu}(m;a,b) != m <=> a*mu(m) > nu(m) (1755-1760), which reduces the change event to {U*mu(X) > nu(X)}. Both conclusions are then computed exactly rather than estimated: P[X != Y] = sum_m (mu(m)-nu(m))^+ through the counting-measure identity proved at 1723-1737, and P[Y = n] = nu(n) by splitting on the two disjoint events producing Y = n and using sum_m (mu(m)-nu(m))^- = d_TV(mu,nu) (1785-1791).
